There is no obfuscation, no unexpected file operations, and no suspicious process spawning. All functionality aligns with the stated purpose: reading and displaying temperature sensor values.

The script accesses system device files and USB vendor IDs via standard Linux sysfs interfaces, which is normal for hardware interaction scripts. It includes proper error handling and uses CRC-16 for Modbus integrity checks. No malicious or suspicious behaviors are present.
